name: tool_search
description: A semantic discovery engine that searches the plugin catalog by functional intent to register external tools (such as file I/O, vision, media, and memory) into the runtime. Use whenever a required capability is not available in your active toolset. Use this to dynamically expand system abilities on demand while keeping prompt context minimal.

top_k.description: How many closest tools to return. Default 3, raise when you need broader options.
